faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Research Fellow position at BITS Pilani, Hyderabad Campus is 30 October 2026. Candidates are encouraged to apply early to avoid any last-minute technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Research Fellow position at the BITS Pilani, Hyderabad Campus for the IRRI sponsored project. This is a project-based contract role.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary for the Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Research Fellow position will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 40,000. This amount is fixed as per the project guidelines provided by the institute.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Masters degree in Economics. Additionally, applicants should have a strong background in applied econometric methods and proficiency in statistical software like Python, R, or Stata for empirical research work.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned in the official notification for the Research Fellow recruitment at BITS Pilani, Hyderabad Campus. Candidates can apply for free by sending their CV via email.

faq.question: Q6. How will the selection process be conducted?
faq.answer: The selection process consists of two stages: first, a shortlisting process based on the submitted CVs, followed by an online interview for the shortlisted candidates to assess their suitability for the research project.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly via email. Interested candidates must send their detailed CV to [email protected] with the subject line "Application for RA - IRRI Project" to be considered for the role.

faq.question: Q8. Is experience in survey data analysis required?
faq.answer: Yes, demonstrated experience in handling and analyzing large-scale survey data is considered essential for this role. Candidates with such experience will be preferred for the Research Fellow position.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should be included in the CV?
faq.answer: Your CV should clearly mention your highest educational degree, relevant research experience, proficiency in statistical tools, and the contact details of at least one professional or academic referee for verification purposes.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the job location for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job location for the Research Fellow position is at the BITS Pilani, Hyderabad Campus, located in the state of Telangana. The role is specifically for an IRRI sponsored research project.
